### Get it running

1. Download **StudyMonitor.exe** below.
2. Put it somewhere you'll keep it, like your Documents folder. It starts with Windows from wherever it is.
3. First time only: right-click it → **Properties** → tick **Unblock** → **OK**. Without this, Windows asks "are you sure?" whenever it starts.
4. Double-click it. It lives in the tray, next to the clock.

Needs Windows 10 or 11. Nothing to install.

**Updating:** right-click the tray icon → **Quit**, replace the old exe with this one, and start it again. Your sessions and settings are kept in `%APPDATA%\StudyMonitor`, so nothing is lost. (If you built it yourself earlier, put this exe in that same `bin` folder to keep using the history stored there.)
